line: Crowley on Atu III: the letter Daleth, Venus, and the path from Chokmah to Binah (pdf p64).

sections.title: Letter, planet and path
sections.line: Crowley on the letter Daleth and the planet Venus, and on Daleth as the path leading from Chokmah to Binah (pdf p64).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Daleth, which means a door, and it refers to the planet Venus.
On the Tree of Life, Daleth is the path leading from Chokmah to Binah, uniting the Father with the Mother.

sections.title: The doctrine of the card
sections.line: Crowley on the formula of the Universe as Love and on the qualities the Empress combines (pdf p64).

quotes.quote: The doctrine implied is that the fundamental formula of the Universe is Love.
She combines the highest spiritual with the lowest material qualities.
